verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents its own credential-issuance mechanism. Admins register OAuth 2.0 client applications and use the Client Credentials Grant to mint bearer tokens, so an agent can get its own dedicated client credentials. The pack never mentions scopes, permission restriction or least-privilege controls on those clients, and API access requires the API add-on. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or per-client permission restriction, least-privilege guidance, token lifetime/revocation controls, independent corroboration.
